data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2024 Syndicate 1301 had opening gross claims outstanding of $739.045m (the 2023 closing balance). Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows a small net gross strengthening of $3.416m (0.46% of opening reserves) driven primarily by an adverse adjustment in the 2021 underwriting year partially offset by releases in 2022. The report also notes net favourable movements of $35.7m in the past year's provision for claims outstanding after expected reinsurance recoveries; the triangle-based gross movement above excludes netting by reinsurers. Technical provisions disclosure indicates prior-year RITC activity (2020 and prior) which may affect comparability of older years.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (3.416m) was calculated from the gross claims development table (pages 68-69) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2024 & 2023) and comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal. The report also cites net favourable prior-year movements of $35.7m (page 60) which are after reinsurance; the triangle provides the gross movement. Technical provisions note indicates RITC transfer of 2020 and prior to Syndicate 2008 on 1 Jan 2023 which may distort older-year comparability. Lob movements listed are taken from the claims note (net of reinsurance) and therefore are net amounts; confidence is lower for those items.
